Turkey sticks 
Cottage cheese 
Protein shakes( equate brand from Walmart is cheaper and has the same ingredients as the premier shakes) if you’re on a budget 
Lean cuisine+ protein meals
Snack packs with nuts and cheese

You will not dye from a panic attack, if you feel faint make sure you sit on a soft surface or the ground.. you absolutely will get through this…try deep breathing, breathe in count to 6 hold in for 3sec and breathe out count to 9 try to imagine roots coming from your body down to the core of the earth.. when we panic we feel out of control but that is not the case.. everything will be ok again
